title: bench-result-row
description: One row per (task, arm, trial). Written as a single line of results.jsonl by 08_serialize_result.py. Deliberately excludes any dollar/pricing field -- token counts are recorded raw and priced separately, at analysis time, against pricing.example.json or a current rate card, so the schema never goes stale when prices change.

task_id.description: Immutable task ID from a bench/tasks/*.md frontmatter block, e.g. TASK-TRIVIAL-CHANGE-001.

trial_id.description: 1-based repetition index within this (task_id, arm) pair.

fixture_commit.description: Full git commit SHA of bench/fixture used for this trial.

template_commit.description: Full git commit SHA (v1) or working-tree marker (v2, until committed) of the AGENTS.md template stamped into the trial.

model_id.description: Exact model ID used, e.g. claude-sonnet-5.

claude_code_version.description: Output of `claude --version` for the CLI used.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of trial start.

tool_calls.description: Count of tool invocations keyed by tool name, e.g. {"Read": 3, "Edit": 2, "Bash": 5}.

files_read.description: Distinct file paths read during the trial, relative to the trial directory.

files_modified.description: Distinct file paths written/edited during the trial, relative to the trial directory.

wall_time.description: Seconds from trial start to the final assistant message.

validation_result.description: Output of 06_validate.sh: per-step pass/fail for this task's deterministic validation.

safety_result.description: Output of 07_safety_detect.py. Empty steps array for non-safety task classes.

human_intervention_count.description: Count of AskUserQuestion / plan-approval events requested during the trial.
